title: Willow Hesitation
description: An E-flat song leans against a quiet three-three-two current. The melody begins to cross its bar lines, briefly finding triplet figures against the unchanged ground. The last return arrives late; the accompaniment gradually sheds its repeated attacks and leaves the phrase suspended on a ninth.
technical_note: Keep the short repeating ground soft while carrying the melody across its accents. Four written triplet groups briefly contradict the accompaniment. Release the pedal at the shared silences and let the final ninth remain light.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.
